senses.zh_definition: 黑密契：外语男性人名；在《饥饿游戏》语境中通常指虚构人物黑密契·阿伯纳西。
senses.en_definition: A masculine personal name, notably that of Haymitch Abernathy in The Hunger Games.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki; dalam konteks siri The Hunger Games, merujuk kepada watak fiksyen Haymitch Abernathy.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不具有可推广到普通事物的马来语词义。此处马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 原文。下列组合用于人物讨论，未作搭配频次认证。人物身份参见 [Scholastic 阅读指南](https://www.scholastic.com/content/dam/scholastic/educators/discussion-guides/scholastic-sunrise-on-the-reaping-reading-guide.pdf)。

messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku baru habis baca tadi. Sedih juga cerita dia, kan?

etymology.historical_story: Haymitch belongs to the fictional naming world of Suzanne Collins's Hunger Games novels. Readers encounter it as the given name of Haymitch Abernathy, whose experiences connect different generations of the story. This literary association establishes the name's referent, but does not establish its linguistic derivation. An explanation based on similar-looking English words would therefore be speculative. [Source](https://www.scholastic.com/content/dam/scholastic/educators/discussion-guides/scholastic-sunrise-on-the-reaping-reading-guide.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /heɪ/ 联想为招呼人的 hey：叫一声“Hey, Haymitch！”来记住这是人名；只是记忆联想，不是词源。
